description.value: Dan's Farm & Country Market is a working farm stand and country market on over 40 acres near Saanichton, selling a wide range of their own-grown vegetables, berries, and tree fruit alongside an in-house bakery and grocery selection. The market is notable for the breadth of its local produce — from a dozen apple varieties to seasonal corn, berries, and squash — as well as Portofino breads, Galloping Goose sausages, and Level Ground coffee. A visiting cyclist can also stop to see the farm animals (ducks, goats, chickens, rabbits) and use a picnic area on site.

The website confirms phone 250.652.9100 (absent from OSM tags) and extensive grocery/produce offerings, but makes no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other amenity checklist items.
